requirements.statement: A generic read-only repository adapter SPI shall emit normalized provenance-bearing Facts and Edges into one deterministic canonical FactGraph.

Filesystem, Git, supported repository metadata, and practical Python semantic dependency behavior shall be implemented as adapters while unsupported ecosystems remain explicitly UNKNOWN or UNSUPPORTED.
The graph shall retain conflicting evidence, apply explicit source precedence only in projections, and expose freshness/staleness tied to source digests.
Impact, capability, context, repository-map, and repository-intelligence compatibility outputs shall be projections over canonical graph facts and edges rather than independent repository models.
Discovered command candidates shall remain distinct from declared commands; discovery shall be read-only, execute no discovered command, and never silently activate policy from filename heuristics.
The migration shall preserve portable paths, deterministic canonical output, legacy compatibility, and shall not implement a reconciler or EvidencePlanner.
